title: 装修网格与立面网格一致
summary: 装修（隔墙）网格与立面网格必须一致，隔墙才能接到窗上；结构网格可以与装修网格错开，这样减少隔墙与柱的连接问题，但有柱的房间会损失面积。因各类构件寿命不同，应选用可适应调整的模数。
cites: The fitting out and façade grids must be the same in order to enable the partitions to connect to the windows.
The structural grid can be offset against the fitting out grid. This reduces the problem of connecting the partitions to columns, but loses space in the rooms, which contain columns.
Because of the different lifecycles of the building elements, an adaptable module dimension should be chosen.

title: 网格模数与建筑进深的搭配
summary: 网格 1.35 m、建筑进深 13.40 m 是组合式办公的经济形式，但用于单间办公时房间过深、比例差；网格 1.50 m、建筑进深 12.50 m 对单间办公或组合式办公都经济，但公共区较窄，靠窗工位比前者少 10%。
cites: Grid module 1.35 m, building depth 13.40 m, an economical form of building for combi-offices, but for single offices this produces deep and badly proportioned rooms.

Grid module 1.50 m, building depth 12.50 m, an economical form of building for single offices or for combi-offices; this provides a narrow communal zone and 10% fewer workstations at the window than with ②.

title: 单排、双排与三排布局
summary: 单排布局不经济、不生态，只有办公室很深时才可接受；双排布局是行政办公楼至今最常用的形式，单间和小办公室都能有自然采光；三排布局（中部设大的服务核心区）通常只对高层建筑合适，其中部可用采光井自然采光。
cites: Single-row layouts are unecological, and only acceptable with deep office rooms (daylight?)
Two-row layouts have mostly been used for administration buildings until now; single rooms and small offices are possible with daylight
A large supply zone at the centre of the building is normally practical only for high-rise buildings (greater proportion of vertical transport).
Lightwells can illuminate the centre of three-row buildings naturally

title: 楼梯间的间距（30 m / 60 m）
summary: 按 MBO 2002，使用房间内任一点到楼梯的距离须 ≤ 35 m；实践中由此得出楼梯间距建筑端部约 30 m、楼梯间彼此间距约 60 m（须注意各州 LBO 的不同规定）。卫生间、楼梯间、电梯井等固定点按建筑法规规定的最大间距布置。
cites: According to MBO 2002, every point in an occupied room must be \( \leq 35 \) m from a staircase.
This in practice leads to a spacing of the staircases from the end of the building of 30 m and from each other of 60 m
Fixed points are sanitary facilities, stairwells, lift shafts etc., situated at maximum spacings defined in the building regulations

title: 组合式办公（combi-office）
summary: 组合式办公：很小的单间办公室用玻璃隔墙与较深的联系区分开，共用设施设在联系区内；每人有一个专注工作的独立工位，中部共用区促进交流。特别适合工作地点可随日程变化的独立、高素质工作。
cites: Combi-office: Very small single offices are separated by glass walls from the deep connection zone, in which communally used infrastructure is located.
It is particularly suitable for independent, highly qualified work where the workplace can change with the daily programme.

title: 单间办公：疏散通道内不得放家具
summary: 单间办公：单人间和双人间沿一条多为人工照明的走廊成排布置；因疏散通道内不允许放置家具，共用设施只能占用使用房间里昂贵的靠窗面积。
cites: Single and double rooms are arranged in rows along a mostly artificially lit corridor.
Jointly used infrastructure occupies expensive window space in occupied rooms, because no furniture is allowed in escape routes.

title: 大空间办公的进深
summary: 大空间（开敞）办公适合主要从事协同工作的大群体和专注度要求低的常规工作；其 20–30 m 的大进深导致建筑设备成本高，改造适应性有限。
cites: are suitable for large groups of employees who are predominantly engaged in shared work and for routine activities with a low concentration threshold.
The extensive room depths of 20–30 m resulted in high costs for building services

title: 非固定工位办公的面积节省
summary: 非固定工位（hot desk / business club）办公：员工的个人区域只限于一个可移动的桌柜单元；结合远程办公或外勤比例高时，比固定工位办公可节省 20–50%。
cites: The personal area of the employee is limited to a mobile desk/cupboard unit.
Combined with teleworking or with a high proportion of travelling representatives, savings of 20–50% are possible compared with personalised offices

title: 可逆办公楼（出租办公）
summary: 可逆办公（Revibüro）其实不是一种办公室类型，而是一种建筑形式；适应性越高设备成本越高，办公室大小和组织上须接受折中；主要适合出租给尚未确定的租户。
cites: The cost of equipment rises with increasing adaptability and compromises have to be accepted concerning office sizes and organisation.
This type of building is mainly suitable for offices for renting to tenants who are not yet known

title: 工位面积的构成
summary: 标准不再规定工位的固定尺寸，而要求有足够的工作面积和活动面积。面积分为：工作面（桌面）、搁置面（家具的平面面积）、家具功能面（门和抽屉开启所需）、工位活动面、交通与通行面；各类面积在不影响功能时可以重叠。
cites: The standard no longer prescribes fixed dimensions for workplaces, but requires sufficient working and movement areas for changing positions at work and for the individually adaptable placing of work equipment.

– work area: table
– shelf area: plan area of the furniture
– furniture function area: space required for doors and drawers
– movement area at the workstation
– traffic and through-passages
The assignments of various areas are differentiated by the standard; however, they can overlap if this results in no limitation of the function.

title: 每工位面积指标（直接工位与交通面积）
summary: 每个工位的平均毛面积指标：直接工位面积 11–15 m²（平均 13 m²），附加面积（洽谈、存放）1.5–4.2 m²（平均 2.5 m²），交通面积 2.2–6.0 m²（平均 4.5 m²）。

title: 屏幕工位与窗的关系
summary: 屏幕工位的视线方向应与窗立面及灯带平行，屏幕尽量位于两者之间。
cites: The view to the screen should be parallel to the window façade and to light bands, with the screen if possible in-between.

title: 档案存放的面积与位置
summary: 档案系统所需面积 = 家具面积 + 通道面积，其中家具面积 = 长 × 宽，通道面积 = ½ 长 × 宽 + 0.5 m；档案系统应设在中心位置；密集架（移动式档案系统）取消中间通道，可节省 100–120% 的空间。
cites:
L × W (filing furniture) = space for furniture
+ ½ L × W + 0.5 m = passage space
The filing system should be centrally located.
enable a space saving of 100–120%) by eliminating intermediate passages

title: 收发室
summary: 收发室负责全部进出邮件和货物的分发；工作位（打包台、分拣台）应足够大，以便高峰时快速分发；面积需求约每工位 0.3–0.5 m²。
cites: Work positions (packing and sorting tables) should be sufficiently large so that distribution can be rapid at peak times.
Space requirement – 0.3-0.5 m² per work position.

title: 数据中心与服务器机房
summary: 数据中心或服务器机房因安装量大，应设 70 cm 高的架空地板并设空调；门禁尤其重要；备份系统应尽量与数据中心分开，设在有防火保护的区域。
cites: These rooms should have a 70 cm raised floor on account of the large amount of installation, and should be air-conditioned.
Back-up systems should if possible be separated from the data centre in fire-protected areas.

title: 全空调对建筑体积的影响
summary: 全空调建筑的总建筑体积和总建造成本是无空调建筑的 1.3–1.5 倍。
cites: The gross built volume and the total construction costs for air-conditioned buildings are 1.3–1.5 times higher than for buildings without air conditioning

title: 立面竖梃与隔墙的连接
summary: 位于模数网格上的立面竖向型材应有足够宽度以连接隔墙；更好的做法是沿立面设置隔声型材；须注意窗的开启扇。
cites: Vertical profiles in the façade, which lie on the modular grid, should be wide enough to connect a partition.
A better solution is with sound-insulated profiles running along the façade.

title: 轻质隔墙的隔声与上下延续
summary: 轻质隔墙的节点要特别注意隔声；采用架空地板和吊顶时，要么让隔墙在竖向上延续，要么这些构件本身须具备隔声性能。
cites: The junctions of light partitions demand particular attention to noise reduction.
With raised access floors and suspended ceilings, either vertical continuation of any possible partitions is to be provided or these elements are to be sound-insulating in themselves

title: 消防电梯（高度超过 30 m）
summary: 高度超过 30 m 的高层建筑须至少设一部位于独立井道内的消防电梯，从它出发在 50 m 半径内须能到达使用房间的每一点；须设带消火栓的前室，其大小应能把担架运进电梯；通道须至少为 T 30 阻火。
cites: In high-rise buildings more than 30 m high, there must be at least one fire service lift in its own shaft, from where every point of an occupied room can be reached within a radius of 50 m.
It must have an anteroom with a hydrant, which is large enough to enable the transport of stretchers to the lift. Access routes must be at least T 30 fire-retarding.

title: 高层疏散楼梯的梯井、排烟与出口
summary: 高层建筑疏散楼梯的梯井须至少 0.80 m 宽（避免在楼梯上铺设水带）；最高处须设排烟口（楼面面积的 5%，但不小于 1 m²）；出口须直通室外，或经过无火灾荷载的门厅。
cites: The wellhole must be min. 0.80 m wide in order to avoid having to lay hoses on the stairs.
Smoke outlets must be provided at their highest point (5% of the floor area but min. 1 m^2).
The exit must be directly into the open air or through a lobby without any fire load.

title: 高层电梯分组
summary: 约 25 层以下通常设一组电梯，所有电梯服务所有楼层；需要超过 6 部电梯时应分成两组。
cites: Up to about 25 storeys, it is usual to provide one group of lifts with all lifts serving all floors. If more than 6 lifts are necessary, they should be divided into two groups.

title: 高层建筑的分级
summary: 高层建筑按距消防车停放面的高度分级：I 级 22–30 m，适用高层建筑规定；II 级 30–60 m，至少 1 部消防电梯；III 级 60–200 m，结构重要构件须为 F 120，并可要求多部消防电梯；IV 级 200 m 以上，审批机关可提出进一步要求。
cites: II | 30–60 m | at least 1 fire service lift
III | 60–200 m | elements of structural significance must be F 120 and many fire service lifts can be required
IV | over 200 m | the approval authority can place further requirements

title: 高层建筑的用途限制
summary: 在德国，按现行法规高层建筑不得用作学校、医院或养老院。
cites: In Germany, use as schools, hospitals or homes for elderly people is ruled out by the applicable regulations.

title: 高层外窗的清洁
summary: 不能从室内安全清洁的窗面，须由受过训练的人员使用合适的设备从室外清洁。
cites: Window areas which cannot be cleaned safely from inside, must be cleaned from the outside by trained personnel using suitable apparatus
